## Owner follow-up

The closed-cone proof uses a choice-free finite-support and Gram-matrix argument instead of the design’s subsequence subroute. The library’s sequential-closure theorem uses \(AC_\omega\) at step 1.2 ([theorem](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-metric-sequential-closure.md>)); importing that route would add an assumption absent from this theorem. I recorded the proof-route difference for owner review. The source readings also confirm that the cited treatments do not supply this finite proof: Peyré–Cuturi defer strong duality to a separate proof, while Santambrogio leaves the inf–sup hypotheses unchecked. ([Peyré–Cuturi](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/1803.00567), [Santambrogio](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1009.3856))
